outcome: Total nucleated cell (TNC) count in umbilical cord blood (UCB)
cohort: 634 UCB units collected for cord blood banking
finding: Vaginal delivery, 40 weeks gestation, and Apgar 1' scores ≤9 were associated with higher TNC counts in UCB.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with higher TNC counts in UCB compared to caesarean delivery.
